diagnosis: The REST endpoint for offline Yjs CRDT update submission accepts binary update buffers and appends them to the crdt_updates database table for any docId provided in the path. It does not check whether req.user has write access to docId. An attacker can tamper with, corrupt, or overwrite collaborative documents across tenants by submitting malicious CRDT updates.
